Name: Gender Neutrality Mod
Author: Hanatsuki
Description:
[center][b][color=#ff0000][size=6]﻿Hana’s [/size][/color][color=#ff7700][size=6]Stardew [/size][/color][color=#ffff00][size=6]Valley [/size][/color][color=#00ff00][size=6]Gender [/size][/color][color=#1e84cc][size=6]Neutrality [/size][/color][color=#9900ff][size=6]Mod[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[size=3]The goal of this mod is to change dialogues directed at the player to be gender neutral and to remove certain gender specific parts of the game. This should allow you to play through the game without being gendered. This mod is made specifically for those of us who wish to play through the game as a gender neutral / nonbinary character. [/size][i][size=3]This mod is for Stardew Valley  v1.5+[/size][/i]
[center][color=#ff0000][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[size=3]The new installation method is rather simple, just follow these steps![/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14426]Install the latest version of GNMTokens[/url]﻿. (if using version 4.0.0+)[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Install the latest version of Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿. (optional, but recommended)[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]
[center][size=5][b][color=#ff7700]General Configuration[/color][/b][/size][/center][size=3]
[center][color=#ff0000]!!! Changes to the config will not take effect until you save them, then relaunch the game !!![/color][/center]
The easiest way to configure this mod is to use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. This will allow you to toggle content from the mod at the title screen of the game! The Generic Mod Config Menu also shows details of what each setting does, so please look there for more information!
If you decide not to use the Generic Mod Config Menu you can still configure the mod manually by editing the “config.json” file within the mod’s folder.
[color=#ff7700]FOR USERS WHO WANT DIFFERENT PRONOUNS FOR OTHER PLAYERS:[/color] Install the mod as normal, then select your pronouns/nouns in the GNMTokens config [b]AND[/b] change the OtherPlayer pronouns to the desired pronouns in the base GNM config [b]AND[/b] be sure FixOtherPlayers is checked in the base GNM config.
[/size]
[size=5][b][color=#ffff00][center]Pronoun Configuration[/center][/color][/b][/size][size=3]
[center][color=#ff0000]!!! Changes to the config will not take effect until you save them, then relaunch the game !!![/color][/center]
[u][b]Pronoun Configuration for version 4.0.0+ is now found in the GNMTokens Config!!![/b][/u]

The easiest way to configure custom pronouns/nouns is once again to use the Generic Mod Config Menu (link above). This will allow you to configure your pronouns/nouns from the mod at the title screen of the game! The Generic Mod Config Menu also shows details of what each setting does, so please look there for more information!
[color=#ffff00]FOR MULTIPLE PRONOUNS: [/color]When adding custom pronouns/nouns you can use multiple sets of pronouns seperated by commas. (For Example: “He, She, They” would select randomly between all three of those pronouns each time they appeared.)
If you decide not to use the Generic Mod Config Menu you can still configure your pronouns/nouns manually by editing the “config.json” file within the mod’s folder.
[/size]
[size=5][b][color=#00ff00][center]What This Mod Does[/center][/color][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Changes the dialogue of all the characters to have them use gender neutral terms to refer to you.[/size]
[*][size=3]Removes the gender symbols in the character creation menu, allowing you to simply choose between body types with a 1 or a 2.[/size]
[*][size=3]Allows you to enter either door at the Spa.[/size]
[*][size=3]Changes Grandpa’s Dialogue in the Intro![/size]
[*][size=3]Changes the Marriage Dialogue![/size]
[*][size=3]Allows you to choose your pronouns and nouns via configuration settings! [/size]
[*][size=3]Changes all of Emily’s Makeover outfits to be Gender Neutral! [color=#00ffff][b]~NEW!~[/b][/color][/size]
[/list]
[center][color=#1e84cc][size=5][b]Other Mods to Consider[/b][/size][/color][/center][list]
[*][size=3][s][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4459?tab=description]No More Dialogue Differences[/url]﻿ by Isilily[/s] With Isilily’s permission this mod now contains many of these changes![/size]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18228]Gender Neutrality Mod compat for [size=3]SVE[/size][/url]﻿[size=3] by Jayjaydub [/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11399]Fix Dialogue Differences[/url]﻿ - This is an exact copy of the Gender Neutrality Mod but in a nondescript, stealthy package for those who rely on others to mod their game for them and fear being outed. It isn’t fool proof, but is much less obvious. This version is not updated for 1.6 yet, but should still work for most dialogues![/size]
[/list]
[center][color=#9900ff][size=5][b]Final Notes[/b][/size][/color][/center][size=3]As always, if you find anything that I missed and still refers to you in a gendered way (or any other bugs) please leave me a comment and tell me where you found it. I will do my best to fix it as soon as possible!
[/size]Extra Bathhouse compatibility thanks to work of nexus user [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/vikich3rry]vikich3rry[/url]!
